response.query: What explicit attitude items and performance-based tasks most validly capture gender stereotyping in dance across ages and differing motor abilities?
response.answer: Explicit attitude items include surveys assessing beliefs about gender roles in dance. Performance-based tasks involve evaluating dance styles for gender-specific traits. These methods effectively capture gender stereotyping in dance across ages and abilities.
